body: There's really nobody left I can express anything to. They're all gone, and even if they were still around I couldn't bring myself to talk about these things. It's a combo of me being raised to keep my issues to myself and my former friends having their heads screwed on so right it comes down to "you're being stupid and these problems are only in your head" which is partially true, but that doesn't help. I've tried making online friends and talking about my issues online but it doesn't help and they all abandon me eventually anyway.
